item.title: Central Bank maintains policy interest rates at current corridor
item.description: CBSL Monetary Board decides to maintain SDFR and SLFR at 8.25% and 9.25% respectively.

item.title: Colombo stock market ASPI gains 45 points on banking turnover
item.description: Foreign inflows recorded in commercial banking counters as CSE turnover crossed 2 billion rupees.
